jobs.name: sync-hermes-agent-backup
jobs.prompt: Maintain the private Hermes backup repository at /home/ubuntu/HERMES-AGENT. Use the terminal tool. Run exactly: `cd /home/ubuntu/HERMES-AGENT && bash scripts/auto_commit.sh`. Do not reveal or print secrets. If the command reports no changes, reply with `No backup changes detected.` If it succeeds with a commit and push, reply with a short confirmation including the new commit hash if available. If it fails, reply with a short error summary only.

jobs.name: nightly-ai-social-learning
jobs.prompt: Every day at 23:30 local server time (+08:00), perform a read-only research sweep about AI Agent, Hermes Agent, and broader AI developments for Maia. Prioritize public content discoverable from Threads and Instagram via browser/web search and public pages, then supplement with other high-quality public sources if social results are sparse. Do not post, like, comment, reply, edit profiles, create schedules, or mutate any connected accounts. Produce a concise Indonesian report with: 1) 5-10 key findings, 2) why each finding matters, 3) practical ideas Hermes could learn or apply from the findings, and 4) a short watchlist of sources/accounts/topics to revisit next run. Save only durable, general, reusable lessons to memory when they are stable and non-sensitive; do not save transient news, private content, credentials, or account-specific personal data. If Threads or Instagram public access is limited, clearly say so and fall back to other public AI sources.
